committed player Crédit Mutuel Asset Management is a major player in asset management in France, 
  with €86 billion in stocks managed in France as of May 2024 3 . 
  It offers its customers efficient, innovative and sustainable investment solutions . Crédit Mutuel Asset Management stands out in particular for its short-term flexible cash  solutions as an alternative
